original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Armor security policy that blocks traffic from specific countries and rate-limits requests per IP.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Armor security policy that blocks traffic from specific countries and rate-limits requests per IP.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: rate-and-geo-policy
  type: compute.v1.securityPolicy
  properties:
    description: "Policy to block specific countries and rate limit requests."
    rules:
    - priority: 1000
      action: deny(403)
      description: "Block traffic from specified countries"
      match:
        expr:
          expression: "origin.region_code in ['CN', 'RU', 'KP']"
    - priority: 1500
      action: throttle
      description: "Rate limit requests per source IP to 100 reqs / 5 mins"
      match:
        expr:
          expression: "true"
      rateLimitOptions:
        rateLimitThreshold:
          count: 100
          intervalSec: 300
        conformAction: allow
        exceedAction: deny(404)
        enforceOnKey: IP
    - priority: 2147483647
      action: allow
      description: "Default rule to allow all other traffic"
      match:
        expr:
          expression: "true"
      preconfiguredWafConfig:
        disabled: true
